data.headline: San Bernardino County approves Fenner Gap JPA

claims.text: San Bernardino County approved a Joint Powers Authority with Fenner Gap Mutual Water Company.

citation.quote:
Joint Powers Authority with Fenner Gap Mutual Water Company
Action: APPROVED (CONSENT CALENDAR) (Pass)

claims.text: Cadiz’s project governance includes San Bernardino County through the Fenner Valley Water Authority, a joint powers authority comprising the County and other public agencies.

citation.quote: the Fenner Valley Water Authority (“FVWA”), the joint powers authority comprised of SMWD, the County of San Bernardino and other public agencies participating in the project

claims.text: The County’s approval is relevant because Cadiz anticipates submitting a third addendum for County and FVWA consideration before using project facilities for imported surplus water storage.

citation.quote: additional project level environmental study and amendments to the GMMMP are required prior to utilizing the project facilities for storage of imported surplus water. We currently anticipate submitting a 3rd Addendum to the Final EIR analyzing storage operations in Q2 2026 for consideration by the County of San Bernardino and FVWA.
